function.arguments: {"reflection":"The initial results provide four useful benchmark sources: an official Rewards for Justice profile (SRC-001) with Conti/Wizard Spider, five aliases, RaaS description, victim counts, and operating methods; a Rapid7 analysis of leaked chats (SRC-002) with leak provenance, limits, internal communications and operational details; a CIS analytical summary (SRC-003) describing the RaaS affiliate model and leak-derived departments, staffing, budgets, and tooling; and a DOJ case page (SRC-004) naming five defendants, case numbers, charges, dates, and one guilty plea. Major gaps remain: no defendant-to-alias links, limited exact chronology, and no indictment/complaint text or primary leak archive in the returned excerpts. Search narrowly for DOJ press releases/indictments, Treasury sanctions, FBI/CISA advisories, and alias links, while preserving source IDs."}
